name: Benchmark Evaluation
purpose: Run repeatable screenplay, shot and studio-orchestration regression fixtures.
scope: Bounded finishing capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for benchmark_evaluation.
Execute the bounded operation: Run repeatable screenplay, shot and studio-orchestration regression fixtures.
Apply benchmark_evaluation-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to studio_orchestrator.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run benchmark_evaluation on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask benchmark_evaluation to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
